prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Generate 5 ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question, each with a short title and a description of one or two sentences. Sample the ideas from the full distribution of possible responses, and give each idea its estimated probability of being generated (a number between 0 and 1).

ideas.title: Longitudinal ATAC-seq/CUT&RUN of AP-1 occupancy after transient stimulus
ideas.description: Profile chromatin accessibility and FOS/JUN binding at multiple timepoints after a transient stimulus (e.g., wounding, inflammation, or stress) and long after stimulus withdrawal. Persistent AP-1-motif-associated accessible sites would indicate a memory-like epigenetic state.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation/inhibition during priming vs. recall
ideas.description: Use degron-tagged FOS/JUN or dominant-negative A-FOS/T-5224 to remove AP-1 either during the initial stimulus or only after it has been withdrawn, then measure the secondary response. Distinguishing a role in establishing versus maintaining memory shows whether AP-1 is required for the memory itself.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome tracking of memory-state heterogeneity
ideas.description: Perform paired scRNA/scATAC-seq on primed and naive cells to link AP-1 motif accessibility and target-gene expression to the strength of the secondary response. Lineage barcoding could show whether the state is inherited through cell divisions.

ideas.title: Live-cell reporters of AP-1 dynamics and re-stimulation
ideas.description: Image endogenously tagged JUN/FOS or AP-1 transcriptional reporters in single cells across repeated stimulus pulses and lineages. Measuring persistence, hysteresis, and heritability of the signal over days would test for memory-like dynamics.

ideas.title: Pioneer-like activity and histone modification analysis at AP-1 sites
ideas.description: Test whether AP-1 binding deposits or maintains H3K27ac/H3K4me1 and recruits BAF at primed enhancers, and whether these marks persist after AP-1 is lost. Combine ChIP-seq, motif mutation by CRISPR, and enhancer reporter assays to show causality.
